gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the cheapest power station on sale today with enough battery for a full 8-hour night on a 350 W concentrator is the Growatt HELIOS 3600 at $1,589 (3,686 Wh, about 9.0 h). That is about $500 below the cheapest overnight-capable model on BlackoutWise's list (Anker SOLIX F3800 Plus, $2,090–$2,700). The BLUETTI Elite 300 at $1,199 runs out at about 7.3 h.
standout_why: I read the two cited rival pages. BlackoutWise (home-oxygen-concentrator-5l) gives price ranges checked October 9, 2026 for 20 models at 350 W. It doesn't list the Growatt HELIOS 3600, the EcoFlow DELTA Pro or the Jackery HomePower 3600 Plus, and its cheapest model that lasts 8 hours or more is the F3800 Plus at $2,090 or more. Willrun (willitrunpower.com) gives no prices at all, only 'Check price on Amazon' links. Neither page has today's maker-store prices, and neither names the cheapest station that actually gets through an 8-hour night. I'm scoring 2, not 3, because I couldn't source the Growatt's UPS switchover time or surge rating, so it can't be named the overnight pick yet.
decides: This changes the overnight pick. At about 350 W, an 8-hour night needs about 3,300 Wh (350 × 8 ÷ 0.85). The cheapest model in stock today that has that much is our Growatt HELIOS 3600 at $1,589. The EcoFlow DELTA Pro costs $1,799 for 8.7 h and the Jackery HomePower 3600 Plus costs $1,899 for 8.7 h, with the black version on pre-order. The BLUETTI Elite 300 at $1,199 stays the budget pick if 7 hours is enough. The Growatt should only be the lead pick once its switchover time is sourced.
